en: Hmm. Your Pokémon has a sharp look about it. I can always tell what kind of treat a Pokémon likes best.
text: Hmm. Pokémonul tău are o privire ascuțită. Pot spune mereu ce fel de gustare îi place cel mai mult unui Pokémon.

en: My husband can tell what any Pokémon likes to eat just by looking at it. Isn't that something?
text: Soțul meu poate spune ce îi place să mănânce oricărui Pokémon doar uitându-se la el. Nu-i grozav?
